description.p: dosui is a lightweight, native Linux frontend for DOSBox — a game and profile launcher and configuration manager in the spirit of D-Fend Reloaded, but without a Java runtime.

ul.li: Profile library with cover art, a sortable details list, and an icon view.
Tabbed profile editor with a live dosbox.conf preview.
New-profile wizard that scans a folder for executables.
Global defaults with per-profile overrides.
Category sidebar and find-as-you-type search.
Import from dosbox.conf (D-Fend / DBGL) and zipped games.
Importing a dosbox.conf keeps the Sound Blaster and Gravis UltraSound settings in the Sound tab, and preserves mount labels.
The library keeps your selection and category filter after a save, favourite, duplicate, delete, or import.
Failed actions are reported in a dialog instead of only in the log.
The built-in DOS Console profile is created on first run.
New Memory, Input, and DOS tabs: XMS/EMS/UMB, video memory, keyboard layout, mouse, joystick, DOS version and country.
Sound tab gains Sound Blaster and Gravis UltraSound IO settings, OPL mode, MPU-401, and a SoundFont picker.
Graphics tab gains fullscreen, VSync, and a shader field; the obsolete scaler field is gone.
New application icon with transparent corners, at all sizes.
Shortcuts refresh the icon/desktop caches so the icon shows immediately.

description.p: Desktop integration and a command-line interface.

ul.li: Opt-in shortcuts: dosui asks before adding an applications-menu entry and a desktop launcher, with Add/Remove buttons in Settings.
Command-line options: --install, --uninstall, --version, --help.
Bundles dosbox-staging 0.82.2.
D-Fend-style layout: category tree, sortable details list, icon view, and a tabbed preview pane.
Built-in "DOS Console" profile with a ready C: drive.
AppImage release pipeline and multi-distro build instructions.
